public_rationale: OpenAI announced product improvements and lower platform prices on November 6, 2023 [e1]. This documents commercial activity before the statement, but does not establish whether the industry's financial and infrastructure demands were sustainable [e1]. The announcement provides no industry-wide comparison of revenue, costs and resource requirements that could settle that broader judgment [e1].
limitations: The statement's hedge, undefined industry boundary and unspecified sustainability standard prevent a determinate assessment as written.
The evidence covers one company's announcement, not comparable industry-wide financial and resource measurements.
Product improvements and lower customer prices do not establish cost coverage or infrastructure sufficiency.
Treating the statement as an absolute denial of commercial activity would remove its qualification.

criteria.contradiction_condition: No determinate contradiction condition can be set. Individual products, revenues or efficiency improvements would not by themselves settle the broader sustainability judgment.
